Terms of use

Effective November 2, 2026.

Purpose and access

PROCURATOR is a private administrative tool operated by the owner for the owner’s use. These public pages explain the app; they do not offer public signup, account access or a subscription service. Access to the Telegram assistant and connected Google account is restricted to the configured owner.

Owner-directed tasks

The assistant uses Google authorization to carry out the owner’s instructions within its enabled tools. The owner is responsible for choosing tasks, reviewing generated drafts and checking factual accuracy before relying on or sharing an output. AI-generated text can contain mistakes or omit context.

Current limits

The current version supports Gmail reading, Google document reading and scoped document and folder creation and file moves within the assistant workspace. It also prepares private plain-text email drafts. Gmail sending requires additional Google consent and a separate authenticated owner approval of the exact recipients, subject and body for each message in Telegram. Edits require a new draft and approval. Ambiguous sends are held for reconciliation rather than retried automatically. iCloud inbox reading requires separate authorization, and requested iCloud draft copies can be saved to Apple Mail Drafts. iCloud sending requires a verified relay and separate owner approval of every exact message. Phone support includes message-taking and short outgoing assignments requiring authenticated owner approval of each exact destination and brief. Conversation timers are below two minutes, with one simultaneous call. Incoming admission is capped at 20 per UTC day and three per caller number; outgoing assignment attempts are capped at 20 per UTC day. Charges remain metered and these are not monetary spending caps. Phone identity is not owner authentication. The phone agent has no account tools; it cannot pay, sign contracts, transfer calls, or file documents. A call receipt or spoken assurance does not establish completion of a legal filing, booking or other task. Complex menus and long holds require owner follow-up. Drive deletion and file-sharing changes remain unavailable. Availability depends on the server and connected providers, and a task may pause or fail when a service or authorization is unavailable.

Browser tasks

The owner can approve an exact, time-limited browser task scope in Telegram for routine entries, specific pages and dropdown choices. Final submissions, consent and other actions outside that scope require separate action approval. Tasks stop at their action budget, session expiry or unresolved uncertainty. A completed click does not establish that a website accepted a reservation, appointment or application; a confirmation must be inspected. Unconfirmed actions are held for inspection and never automatically repeated. The first browser integration uses fresh sessions lasting up to 15 minutes, without saved login contexts or automated uploads. Login, verification, identity-number and payment forms require owner takeover. Website availability, account restrictions and browser-service limits can prevent completion.

Account services and data

Use of Google, Apple, Anthropic, Telegram, DigitalOcean, Browserbase, Twilio and web-search providers remains subject to those services’ applicable terms. The privacy notice explains what the assistant accesses, where information is processed and how the owner can revoke access or request deletion of retained server records.

Contact and updates

Contact owner@example.com about this app. These terms describe the current private deployment and will be updated when enabled features change.
